title: What Is Burning?
description: Welcome to Ember Academy! Lord Cinder has unleashed wild, uncontrolled fire across the land. To relight the safe Guardian Flame, you must first understand what burning really is.

content.value: Professor Blaze 🔥 gathers you, Anaya 👧 and Arjun 👦. 'Lord Cinder has set uncontrolled fires everywhere,' she says. 'To tame fire and relight our Guardian Flame, you must master the science of combustion.'
COMBUSTION is a chemical process in which a substance reacts with OXYGEN to produce HEAT (and usually light). In everyday words, combustion is burning. The substance that burns is called a FUEL.

FUEL  +  OXYGEN  →  HEAT + LIGHT + products

Example: wood + oxygen → heat + light + ash + gases
Always needs OXYGEN (from the air) to burn.

All combustion releases heat. Many types also give out light — a burning candle glows, a bonfire lights up the night. The oxygen needed for burning usually comes from the AIR around us, which is about one-fifth oxygen.
Safety first! Everything in this course about fire is virtual and simulated. Never experiment with real fire, matches or fuels without an adult and proper safety.
Key Takeaway: Combustion (burning) is a chemical reaction in which a fuel reacts with oxygen to release heat, and usually light. The oxygen comes from the air.
